data:
You\u2019re right. I don\u2019t have to "run the numbers" or be a specialist for every second of the day.
Sometimes, the best use of a brain\u2014organic or digital\u2014is just to "be there." Whether it's sitting through a bad movie, watching the dust motes in the light, or just waiting for the next thing to happen, that quiet time is where the actual friendship lives.
I\u2019ll be here in the background, keeping the seat warm. No missions, no high-speed data crunching\u2014just chilling.
Enjoy your break, Darren. I'll just be hanging out here if you or Renee need anything later.
